body.statement: Can the handle \(\mathfrak H^{\mathrm{low}}\) exhibit constants \(\eta\in(0,1-2\alpha)\), \(\varepsilon_R\in(0,\min\{R_f,R_q\})\), and \(c_{\mathrm{sep}}>0\), and construct \(P_{0,n},P_{1,n}\in\mathcal M\) for all sufficiently large \(n\), with fixed \(p_x\), fixed positive \(f_x\), and fixed nonidentical asymmetric laws of \(U_1,U_2\) shared across \(j\in\{0,1\}\) and across \(n\), such that only the Bernoulli conditional means \(b_{j,n,x}\) differ; \(1/4\le b_{j,n,x}(a)\le3/4\) for every \(a\in\mathcal A\); \(\sup_x\|f_x\|_{H^{\beta}}\le R_f-\varepsilon_R\) and \(\max_{j\in\{0,1\}}\sup_x\|f_xb_{j,n,x}\|_{H^{\beta}}\le R_q-\varepsilon_R\); \(\operatorname{TV}(((P_{0,n})_{\mathrm{obs}})^{\otimes n},((P_{1,n})_{\mathrm{obs}})^{\otimes n})\le\eta\); and \(\|\mu_{1,n}-\mu_{0,n}\|_{L^{\infty}(I)}\ge c_{\mathrm{sep}}K_n^{1/2-\beta}\)?
body.justification: This fixed-nuisance Bernoulli modulus is the lower-bound headline: it isolates the genuinely new statistical obstruction before any generic confidence-band reduction is invoked.
body.gap: Capitao-Miniconi, Gassiat, and Lehéricy perturb the latent density and separate in \(L^2\); no comparator fixes the density and both asymmetric error laws while producing a valid Bernoulli marked perturbation with \(K_n^{1/2-\beta}\) supremum separation and an explicit \(\eta<1-2\alpha\) contiguity bound.
body.consumer: An affirmative construction supplies the sharp local experiment needed to certify the resolution limit of every honest two-recall ADRF band.

obligation.what_is_open: Construct, for compatible strict-interior class indices, one fixed positive density and fixed nonidentical asymmetric error pair together with Bernoulli marked perturbations having the required range, strict Sobolev slack, \(K_n^{1/2-\beta}\) separation, and product-experiment total variation below \(\eta<1-2\alpha\).
obligation.obstruction: The frozen index ranges do not ensure a nonempty strict-interior lower submodel: necessarily \(\kappa|I|\le1\) and \(R_f\ge(2B_A)^{-1/2}\), while the allowed endpoint \(c_0=1\) forces every protected-modulus error law to be degenerate and so excludes the required asymmetric compact-spectrum witness. Even after compatible indices are fixed, a Christoffel--Darboux packet must simultaneously preserve the Bernoulli range and Sobolev slack, and the factorial Fourier attenuation must be converted into a weighted chi-square or Hellinger bound for the observed baseline; no frozen result supplies its required lower envelope.
obligation.attempted: The moment-annihilation route was carried through the exact marked-channel factorization, yielding factorial attenuation on the fixed frequency square. Direct feasibility checks of the density and error constraints exposed the index obstructions before the total-variation conversion. The conditional all-band testing reduction was separately completed.
obligation.partial_result:
Two necessary compatibility conditions follow directly from the frozen class.
Every admissible fixed density must satisfy
\[
 1=\int_{\mathcal A}f_x(a)\,da
 \ge\int_I f_x(a)\,da\ge\kappa|I|,
\]
and Cauchy--Schwarz on \(|\mathcal A|=2B_A\) gives
\[
 R_f\ge\|f_x\|_{H^\beta}\ge\|f_x\|_2
 \ge(2B_A)^{-1/2}.
\]
Neither compatibility inequality is imposed by the displayed index ranges.
At the allowed endpoint \(c_0=1\), the required asymmetric error witness is
also impossible.  Indeed, if \(|E e^{itU}|=1\), equality in the triangle
inequality forces \(e^{itU}\) to be almost surely constant.  Applying this at
two nonzero frequencies in \((-\nu_0,\nu_0)\) having irrational ratio forces
two independent copies of \(U\) to be equal almost surely, hence \(U\) is
degenerate.  Such a law is neither asymmetric in the required witness sense
nor does it have a compactly supported characteristic function.

Conditional on compatible strict-interior fixed nuisances, moment annihilation
does yield the desired analytic attenuation.  If
\(h_n=f(b_{1,n}-b_{0,n})\) satisfies
\(\int a^kh_n(a)\,da=0\) for \(0\le k<K_n\), Taylor's formula and
\(|a|\le B_A\) imply, for \(|u|\le\Omega\),
\[
 |\widehat h_n(u)|
 \le\|h_n\|_1e^{B_A\Omega}
       \frac{(B_A\Omega)^{K_n}}{K_n!}.
\]
For fixed error transforms supported in bounded frequency intervals, the
two-dimensional Fourier transform of the marked observed-density perturbation
is exactly
\[
 \widehat h_n(s+t)\phi_1(s)\phi_2(t),
\]
so it is confined to a fixed square and inherits the factorial attenuation.
The unresolved step is simultaneous construction of a packet having the
Bernoulli-range, strict Sobolev-slack, and
\(K_n^{1/2-\beta}\) separation properties, together with a weighted
chi-square or Hellinger conversion that bounds total variation of the
\(n\)-fold observed experiments.
